articles.title: NYC council announces probe into ‘predatory marketing practices’ on prediction markets
articles.description: Council Speaker Julie Menin sent letters to four companies offering prediction market services to New Yorkers as part of an investigation into their marketing practices.

articles.title: Kraken adds S&P 500 to funded trading program, commodities to follow
articles.description: Kraken’s funded trading program adds round-the-clock exposure to the US equity benchmark as it builds out its multi-asset offering.

articles.title: Bitwise cuts 14% of staff while still expecting growth
articles.description: Crypto companies from including Coinbase, BitGo, Robinhood, Polygon and Pump.fun have announced workforce reductions this year, citing a variety of reasons, including shifting to AI and market forces.

articles.title: FlightAware drops Kalshi lawsuit one day after filing
articles.description: Following the initial lawsuit, at least one of Kalshi’s event contracts was changed to list “Primary Source Agency” as the entity behind verifying flight cancellation data.

articles.title: Bank of England tests stablecoin, digital pound interoperability in cross-border payments
articles.description: The Digital Pound Lab is testing a cross-border trade finance flow combining stablecoin payments with simulated digital pound settlement.

articles.title: HashKey begins beta distribution of Hong Kong-regulated HKDAP stablecoin
articles.description: HashKey has become an authorized distributor for Anchorpoint’s HKDAP, expanding institutional access as Hong Kong’s regulated stablecoin market takes shape.

articles.title: Bitcoin eyes $63K as US CPI relief sends September Fed rate pause odds to 60%
articles.description: Bitcoin price action did not reflect relief in US CPI inflation numbers matching expectations amid a warning over $63,000 failing as support.

articles.title: Kalshi launches sports and crypto perps data feed on DoubleZero
articles.description: Kalshi launched access to its sports and crypto perpetual data feed through DoubleZero’s dedicated fiber network to bolster institutional data access.

articles.title: Slovenia joins EU’s MiCA stablecoin register with first issuer
articles.description: Slovenia entered the EU’s MiCA stablecoin register through electronic money institution Dinaro, as the update also added two new CASPs.

articles.title: El Salvador’s Bitcoin experiment turns 5: ‘It was for us, not them’
articles.description: Five years after El Salvador made Bitcoin legal tender, the experiment has fallen short of its original promises for locals, but it’s been great for Bitcoin’s global profile.

articles.title: Wintermute to pour $1B into AI, high-frequency trading amid TradFi expansion: Report
articles.description: Wintermute will reportedly invest $1 billion in AI infrastructure and high-frequency trading as part of its expansion into traditional finance.

articles.title: Fidelity files with SEC to add staking to Ethereum ETF
articles.description: Fidelity plans to add staking to its Ether fund, with 85% of rewards retained by FETH and quarterly cash distributions planned for investors.

articles.title: Binance, RedotPay clash over fate of Singapore lawsuit
articles.description: Amid a $473 million legal dispute, RedotPay says it expects Binance to end its Singapore case, while Binance says its claims remain active.

articles.title: Bitcoin miners earn under 0.7% of revenue from fees in new 10-year low
articles.description: Bitcoin miners showed a “concerning” trend of pivoting to AI amid a profit squeeze as transaction-fee income barely bounced from 10-year lows of 0.52% of revenue.

articles.title: Crypto companies urge AI firms to give Bitcoin developers early access
articles.description: The Bitcoin Policy Institute and other industry participants urged AI companies to offer early access to their frontier models to aid Bitcoin and open-source developers in their cybersecurity efforts.

articles.title: Inside the fake crypto startup that fooled North Korean IT workers
articles.description: Suspected North Korean IT workers joined a fake crypto startup — without realizing their every move was being tracked to extract valuable intel.

articles.title: Harmony considers rollback after suspected exploit inflates ONE supply
articles.description: Harmony is working with exchanges to freeze funds and is preparing a patch after claims that 2.8 billion unauthorized ONE hit trading platforms.

articles.title: CFTC invokes emergency powers to keep Kalshi operating in New York fight
articles.description: The order escalates a jurisdictional fight over whether states may treat federally regulated event contracts as illegal gambling.

articles.title: Ravencoin hits record low as network exploit puts transactions at risk
articles.description: Mining pools controlling most of Ravencoin’s hash rate are building a competing chain that could trigger a three-day reorganization.

articles.title: SEC, CFTC sue Goliath Ventures over $400M crypto Ponzi scheme
articles.description: Regulators allege Goliath promised crypto liquidity-pool returns but instead paid earlier investors and funded its founder’s luxury spending.

articles.title: SEC to address crypto regulations in absence of CLARITY passage
articles.description: The US securities regulator scheduled a meeting this week with the potential to step up on digital asset policies without congressional action.

articles.title: Itaú joins Brazil tokenization pilot with OpenAssets
articles.description: The bank will test tokenized fixed-income securities and investment funds as part of an ANBIMA-led industry pilot.

articles.title: MoneyGram expands crypto cash ramps to Solana
articles.description: MoneyGram’s Ramps service now connects Solana wallets and applications to its global cash network, with Rift becoming the first wallet to integrate the service.

articles.title: Following Senate delay, crypto bill has narrow window to become law
articles.description: After an August recess, lawmakers in the Senate will have just 36 days in session before the end of the year to pass the CLARITY Act.

articles.title: Strategy CEO says company will resume Bitcoin accumulation this year
articles.description: The company has bought roughly 25 times more BTC than it has sold this year, despite recent sales that challenged its long-standing accumulation strategy.

articles.title: ARP Digital secures Dubai VARA broker-dealer license
articles.description: The license allows ARP Digital to offer regulated digital asset and stablecoin conversions into UAE dirhams as it expands its Gulf presence beyond Bahrain.

articles.title: FlightAware sues Kalshi over flight cancellation data
articles.description: The legal action against Kalshi focused on trademark infringement and injury to its reputation in addition to citing state authorities comparing the company’s contracts to gambling.

articles.title: Coinbase-backed Flowdesk secures full broker-dealer license in Dubai
articles.description: Flowdesk’s VARA approval follows its MiCA authorization in France as crypto firms build regulated operations across major global markets.

articles.title: Nasdaq to acquire LeveL Markets in push toward ‘always-on’ markets
articles.description: Nasdaq’s acquisition of the third-largest US alternative trading system comes as the exchange operator expands into tokenized securities and longer trading hours.

articles.title: Bitcoin drops to one-week low as retail buys gold at highest prices since June
articles.description: Bitcoin price action sank to one-week lows ahead of US CPI data, while retail investors piled into gold ETFs and XAU/USD hit its highest levels in nine weeks.
